brief:
Families across Gaza are preparing for a fourth consecutive winter living in tents and makeshift shelters, UN News reported, as humanitarian operations confront escalating obstacles. Transport operations were suspended Tuesday after Israel closed the Kerem Shalom crossing for its election day.

The closure of Gaza's key aid entry point has compounded existing constraints on relief delivery to the territory's displaced population, already struggling through years of displacement and inadequate shelter.
dek: Families in Gaza are bracing for a fourth winter in tents and makeshift shelters as UN aid operations face mounting obstacles, with transport suspended on Tuesday due to Israel’s closure of the key Kerem Shalom crossing for election day.
title: Gaza families face fourth winter in tents as UN aid stalls
